_about: Per-turn figures a correct Codex parser should extract from each fixture in this folder. All fixtures are synthetic; ids, paths and prompts are invented. Field names and nesting are taken from the openai/codex source at commit e72da2b53805894878023d01949a25a082e0a5cb (26 September 2026) and from the older tags named per generation.

_conventions.input_tokens_raw: payload.info.last_token_usage.input_tokens exactly as recorded. INCLUSIVE of cached and cache-write tokens.
_conventions.cached_input_tokens: subset of input_tokens that was a prompt-cache read
_conventions.cache_write_input_tokens: subset of input_tokens written to the prompt cache. Only exists in the current generation; absent before.
_conventions.uncached_input_tokens: input_tokens_raw - cached_input_tokens - cache_write_input_tokens. This is the slice billed at the plain input rate.
_conventions.output_tokens: INCLUSIVE of reasoning_output_tokens; do not add reasoning on top
_conventions.dedupe_key: what to key on so a repeated event is not counted twice

fixtures.generation: G2 envelope, no turn_context (Codex CLI between rust-v0.31.0 and rust-v0.35.x, roughly Sep to Oct 2025)
notes: No turn_context line exists in this generation and SessionMeta carries no model, so the model is unrecoverable from the log. ccusage substitutes "gpt-5" and flags the row is_fallback_model = true.
TokenUsage has no cache_write_input_tokens field in this generation.
TokenCountEvent has no rate_limits field in this generation.
Line 7 is a byte-identical repeat of line 6 and must be dropped.

expected_skipped_lines.reason: duplicate token_count: info.total_token_usage is unchanged from line 6, so no new usage happened

fixtures.dedupe_key: (session file, info.total_token_usage snapshot). Count last_token_usage only when the cumulative total_token_usage differs from the previous one seen in this file.

fixtures.generation: G3 envelope with turn_context (rust-v0.36.0 onward; rate_limits on token_count from roughly rust-v0.4x)
notes: Model comes from the most recent turn_context line and changes mid-file.
Line 7 carries info: null, which happens when only rate limits refreshed. It must be skipped, not treated as a zero turn.
Line 6 repeats line 5's totals exactly and must be dropped.
The web_search_call response item on line 4 is a billed extra for the provider but carries no token counts of its own; its cost is inside the next token_count.

expected_skipped_lines.reason: info is null, rate limit refresh only

fixtures.dedupe_key: (session file, info.total_token_usage snapshot), same rule as G2

fixtures.generation: G4 current, paginated history mode (main at e72da2b, 26 September 2026)
notes: Lines now carry an "ordinal" and the file also contains token_usage_record lines that repeat the same numbers. Count EITHER the token_count stream OR the token_usage_record stream, never both, or every figure doubles.
cache_write_input_tokens exists in this generation and is a subset of input_tokens.
service tier comes from the thread_settings_applied events and is state that carries forward: turns 1 and 2 are "default" (standard), turn 3 is "priority" (fast).
Line 6 repeats line 5's totals exactly. Line 10 has info: null.

expected_skipped_lines.reason: duplicate token_count, ordinal 5, cumulative total unchanged from ordinal 4
info is null, rate limit refresh only

fixtures.dedupe_key: token_count stream: (session file, info.total_token_usage snapshot), or equivalently the line ordinal plus a changed cumulative. token_usage_record stream: payload.response_id, which is unique per upstream response.

fixtures.generation: codex exec --json stdout, saved to a file by the user. Not a rollout. ccusage reads these when a CODEX_HOME entry has neither sessions/ nor archived_sessions/.
notes: turn.completed carries no timestamp and no model. A parser must fall back to the file mtime for the date and has no model at all; ccusage substitutes "gpt-5".
Usage here is per turn, not cumulative, so no delta arithmetic and no dedupe by cumulative total.
Usage has no total_tokens field; derive it as input_tokens + output_tokens.
fixtures.dedupe_key: none needed: every turn.completed is its own turn and nothing repeats

_abbreviations_in_fixtures: gen4 thread_settings_applied: the real ThreadSettingsSnapshot also requires permission_profile and collaboration_mode, whose inner shapes were not enumerated. Those two keys are omitted from the fixture. Every key that IS present matches the source.
gen4 session_meta omits optional fields that carry skip_serializing_if and would not appear when unset.
